reviews.text:
Ms. Dang-ay,
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with our team.

During a regular checkup, Dr. Poulin diagnosed my cat with mammary cancer. We were able to get her the surgery right away before it became malignant. 5 years later, she’s a normal, healthy cat thanks to her knowledge and expertise. I cannot be more grateful to her.

It is difficult to find the words to express how grateful we are to Dr. Poulin for the compassion, dignity, and humanity she showed our beloved Chester during his final moments.
From the moment we arrived, Dr. Poulin treated Chester not simply as a patient, but as a cherished member of our family. She took the time to ensure he was comfortable, and she guided us through one of the hardest decisions a pet owner can face with remarkable kindness, patience, and understanding.
What stood out most was her genuine empathy. She gave us the space we needed to say goodbye, never rushing us, while offering reassurance and support throughout the process. Her calm presence brought comfort during an incredibly painful time.
Losing Chester broke our hearts, but thanks to Dr. Poulin, his passing was peaceful, gentle, and filled with love. We will always remember the respect and compassion she showed both Chester and our family.
Dr. Poulin is not only an exceptional veterinarian, but also a truly caring and compassionate human being. We are forever grateful for the kindness she showed during one of the most difficult days of our lives.
Thank you, Dr. Poulin, for helping Chester cross the rainbow bridge with such dignity and love. We will never forget it. ❤️🐾

I have been bringing my dogs there for almost 20 years. Ever since they went corporate everything there went downhill.
I recently paid $500 to have a growth near the bum hole of my 14 year old Pug that was analyzed. A week or so later someone from the vet tried calling me after 9pm, which is pretty unusual. I returned the call the next day during business hours to see what's what. It turns out that they say it might be this  but they don't know. Turns out they didn't preform a biopsy that we were mislead to believe and I paid $500 for a maybe this, or a maybe that. When I went to the location to get a copy of the report  it was only provided in french, as well as categorized my Pug as a Beagle even though that dog has a file there for at least 10 years.
I have now had all my dogs files transferred to another (non corporate) vet down the street, as I will never use their services again.
A note to the owner/management. Do not reply to my post and review with some BS damage control.
Your business has turned lousy and you lost me as a customer for good, and I hope that others follow me since your only real concern is your bottom line and not our pets.
thank you for this wonderful review!

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star review! We greatly appreciate your support and are delighted that your experience met your expectations. We look forward to seeing you again soon! 😊

Thank you for leaving us a 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are so glad you had a great experience. We look forward to seeing you again soon! 😊

A fast, efficient team who love their work and animals. A very humane approach, too. Dr. Poulin agreed immediately, despite her busy schedule, to take on my pet as an emergency, and I can't thank her enough. I felt safe with them. I transferred my pet's file to this clinic for the rest of Astra's life.

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star review! We greatly appreciate your support and are delighted that your experience met your expectations. We look forward to seeing you again soon! 😊

Thank you for leaving us a 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are so glad you had a great experience. We look forward to seeing you again soon! 😊

If I could give them less than zero atars, I would. I was late for my appointment with a very sick cat, called them before the appointment to inform them that I would be late; no one answered and there was no option to leave a voicemail. I have a file with them since 2010. So they called me, I explained to them the situation and she said she would need to ask the vet because "after 15 minutes the vet has other patients." Apparently, the vet couldn't see me. I had to hang up the phone so I wouldn't cry. After 25 minutes I had to call them back because she didn't even have the decency to call ME back! Unbelievable. DO NOT CHOOSE THIS VET CLINIC as they lack basic human decency.

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star review! We greatly appreciate your support and are delighted that your experience met your expectations. We look forward to seeing you again soon! 😊

Thank you for leaving us a 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are so glad you had a great experience. We look forward to seeing you again soon! 😊

Amazing amd caring staff
Dre Poulin is an amazing vet

I've always had dogs and I know a number of veterinarians; the best so far, at a very reasonable price, who gave me a level of service I haven't experienced anywhere else—kindness and understanding. He gave my dog ​​a sedative injection before the lethal injection. My Golden Retriever passed away without any pain or even realizing it after 14 years of loyalty and love.

They were incredibly kind, punctual, and didn't push for hundreds of tests or procedures. I felt completely at ease.

Thank you!

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star review! We greatly appreciate your support and are delighted that your experience met your expectations. We look forward to seeing you again soon! 😊

Thank you for leaving us a 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are so glad you had a great experience. We look forward to seeing you again soon! 😊
Excellent friendly staff and vet

Only positive experiences at this clinic. Went for routine vaccination and the technician patiently answered all my questions and concerns and hypotheticals as an anxious cat mom without feeling rushed. Nothing but kindness and patience for my terrified kitty! Will continue to trust this clinic with his care
My Sphynx cats Pablo and Cleo and senior Maltipoo Michou get such incredible care from Dr Poulin 🙏🩷 She’s amazing …

The vet was kind but didn't believe me at all when I told him that my cat's mammary lumps had been analyzed and found to be benign a few months earlier. He also didn't believe me when I said that having them removed had cost me less than $2,000 in Quebec City (while he estimated a minimum of $4,000…) for my other cat who had the same thing. I sensed a false air of compassion from him, which disappointed me greatly given my cat's condition. He seemed reluctant to run tests (possibly to avoid wasting my money unnecessarily, but for me, it was impossible to have my cat euthanized without being certain I couldn't save her).

We first came to The Animal Health Clinic in 2024 after a heartbreaking experience at another clinic. Although they were fully booked, the receptionist took the time to speak with Dr. Forté, who kindly agreed to see Dory that evening. That act of kindness changed everything, and I genuinely believe it saved her life.

Instead of leaving with no answers or hope, we left with a treatment plan that worked. Since then, Dory has been diagnosed with stage 2 CKD and has also undergone dental surgery with Dr. Poulin. Because of her kidney disease, the team kept her overnight for fluids before surgery, and I was so grateful for the extra care they provided. She recovered beautifully after five extractions and came home like a new cat. We’ve also seen Dr. Châteauneuf, who has always been kind, knowledgeable, and reassuring.

When it was time to say goodbye to our other cat, Madame Murray, Dr. Poulin cared for her with incredible empathy. She reassured us that we were making the right decision, and I’ll always be grateful for the support she gave us during one our hardest days.

Everyone we’ve encountered at this clinic has been wonderful. Dory is now 15 years old, and I wouldn’t trust her care to anyone else.

Avoid this clinic. They've been bought by private equity, so their entire purpose is now profit and not the wellbeing of your pets. It doesn't matter how good the vets and staff are if they're operating inside a corporation that sees your pet as dollar signs.

I hope the staff bands together and starts their own independent clinic, because they're great and deserve better.
Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a review! 😊 …

Technician was very rude; tough, not a smile, not a care from a human being to another. I was told I was cruel with my animal, false accusations as such hurt people. Insisted on bringing back animal..... dollar signs...... Very disappointed. Not returning. No trust for such behaviour.

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. We appreciate your feedback and look forward to seeing you again soon!

Thank you for taking the time to review us. We appreciate your feedback and look forward to seeing you again soon!

The team at the Animal Health Clinic is very professional, kind, welcoming, and capable. They communicate very clearly, always have availabilities when I call, and make me feel comfortable knowing my puppy is in caring and capable hands.

It was just me and my Malinois mix, buddy, together for 13 wonderful years. He was my best friend and my family. He died on a Sunday so my veterinarian wasn’t available. Called them in advance, came in, and they couldn’t be bothered to leave the front desk when I walked in with my 70lbs dead dog in my arms. Instead my greeting was to be yelled at to turn and go the other way. I asked again “where?” between tears, got yelled at again. Never been there before so didn’t know where to go. Nobody came to see me, nobody helped. This happened in the last week of November, 2025. It’s almost 8 months later now and it still haunts me that I had to leave my buddy there with those awful people. This location should go back to being a bank. Even they have more heart and empathy/sympathy. I’ll always hold this place as the benchmark for bad service and how not to treat people. That was the worst experience I’ve ever had at any business, and all without me ever saying 2 words.

Friendly, efficient, knowledgeable and kind, from the front desk to the excellent care and advice offered by Dr. Chateauneuf. Highly recommend. Romeo the bulldog adds that the treats are most excellent.
Went with my daughter with her dog and cat for yearly checkup and busters. Excellent service.

From the moment we arrived until the time we left, the care we received was outstanding. The receptionist, the technicians, and especially the veterinarian treated Bruno with kindness, professionalism, and genuine care.

Everyone was friendly, attentive, and made sure Bruno felt comfortable throughout the visit. We truly appreciate the excellent service and the compassionate treatment we received.

Thank you for taking such good care of Bruno! 😀
Staff is very welcoming, vet techs and doctors are excellent.  Frankie left with a belly fully of treats

Thank you for taking the time to send us this wonderful review!

Thank you for taking the time to send us this great review!

Excellent service. The vet was very professional. My dog ​​is in excellent health. Therefore, the care is preventative (exams, vaccinations, medication for Lyme disease). I don't understand why the bill is always so high at the vet! In my opinion, the fees are excessive.
Dr. Poulin is a very professional and caring veterinarian. She saved our pet on a Saturday when no other place could help us. I highly recommend her.

A passionate and dedicated vet, *Dr. Poulin*, provided an experience beyond my expectations. She saved our little kitten, Fluffy. We thank her from the bottom of our hearts, and her price was realistic for a young couple like us. 😇🥰 I recommend her 100%! ❤️‍🩹 …
Dr Poulin is the animal whisperer. She always seems to find the problem without delay and explains everything you need to know in terms that make it easy to understand. Highly recommended
I love this clinic! Our vet, Dr. Chateauneuf, is super friendly and really kind! He always answers our questions and is very patient with our anxious dog!
Great vet!
Today we had to euthanize my cat who was  14 years old and they made such a painful moment feel gentle and peaceful and made us feel like we were in good hands every step of the way

Thank you so much for this 5-star review. We look forward to seeing you again.

Thank you so much for this 5-star review. We look forward to seeing you again.
My dog, Linkie, received a warm welcome and excellent care today at Vet et Nous Animal Clinic in Notre Dame de Grace.  Thank you all!!

We are very grateful for this wonderful review. Thank you very much.

We are truly grateful for this wonderful review. Thank you very much.

Very kind team. However, critical thinking may be lacking.
A misdiagnosis ultimately led to the deterioration of my cat’s health, which could have potentially been avoided if they had recommended and run the appropriate bloodwork. They assumed my cat had pancreatitis and they only ran the bloodwork to confirmed that diagnosis. When I asked what could cause pancreatitis, they stated that they often don’t know (which is true). However, I asked if there’s a possibility my cat could be suffering from an infection due to the dental surgery she had a week prior. They said very unlikely and that they could run a blood test to just reassure my worries. In the end, they did not run the test for infection because their machine was broken but reassured me that it’s very unlikely that she has an infection and the pancreatitis will get better over time. Unfortunately, she did have an infection, went into septic shock and passed away.
I was also extremely shocked that they charged me $100 to transfer the file of my cat to the ICU in Brossard.

We love this clinic ❤️ the receptionists are lovely and all the vets and techs we've seen were all so nice and receptive. They do what is necessary without being pushy and explain everything very well. They hear our concerns and always answer our questions.
Our babies are well taken care of and we always trust this team!

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We are delighted that our services met your expectations. Your satisfaction is our priority, and we are happy to know that you are satisfied with the attention and care provided. Thank you for your trust, and see you soon!

Thank you for your 5-star review! We are delighted that our services met your expectations. Your satisfaction is our priority, and we are happy to know that you are satisfied with the attention and care provided. Thank you for your trust, and see you soon!

Corporate takeover ruined what was once a wonderful clinic. The pricing is designed to obscure rather than inform, the communication style punishes questions, and the marketing exploits fear. It’s clear their business model depends on you not asking too many questions.
Much better options available locally if you care about fair dealing and actual animal welfare. We will not be back.

A real clinic! All the staff, from entering to paying out are cordial and warm but most important very thoroughly professional.
They answer questions and propose solutions that will work for you and your pets.

Multiple times they have given us condescending tone when we ask about the price of something. They raised the price of my cat’s meds by 30$ and made me feel like I was poor and crazy for noticing the difference.
Always courteous and helpful. Staff is friendly and make Kira feel comfortable

Very disappointed with my experience. I was charged a $23 annual prescription fee on top of the medication cost just to get a flea and tick prescription, plus $50 for an anal gland expression—both feel excessive.

The clinic seems more focused on making money than providing care, and their emails come across as fear-based marketing. I’ve since found a nearby vet who is much more reasonable and compassionate.

Would not recommend.

Thank you for taking the time to review your visit. It is greatly
appreciated.

They seem to have a lot of respect for both human and animal visitors, and the clinic appears very well-run. I say "appears" because I rarely go to the vet, having the privilege of owning a healthy pet. When I had an emergency a few years ago, the clinic saw us quickly, and a veterinarian did what was necessary, successfully treating my animal.

This was the third vet that we brought out cat to in the past week due to ongoing dental issues (that ended up being kidney failure). Dr Robinson and the two vet techs that helped us (I’m sorry for not remembering their names) were phenomenal. They displayed professionalism, great communication, and genuinely looked out for the wellbeing of our cat and us as owners. There was no price gouging, no trying to sell you on unnecessary tests, etc. Although saying goodbye to our cat was very difficult, they did everything in their power to make it comfortable for all of us. They even stayed almost 2 hours past closing to allow us to have ample time to say goodbye to our fur baby. All in all, I would HIGHLY recommend this clinic to anybody who wants genuinely good care for their animal. Thank you to the staff for everything!
EXCELLENT SERVICE AND CARE - MERCI!

Staff were all great. They took good care of Rolo. I would give 4.5 stars if the physical space was nicer.
The physical space is in an older building and the rooms had poor ventilation so quite uncomfortable whilr waiting, but does not take away from the service provided which was 5 stars

I had to say goodbye to my best friend urgently. The Vet et Vous clinic at 5601 Sherbrooke West was the only one willing to take me in at the last minute. The entire clinic was very understanding. I even received a sympathy card some time later. I have never been treated so well, and I have already recommended this clinic to my next pet. Even though it's far from home, the feeling of respect makes all the difference.
Thank you again to the whole team.
Excellent clinic, great attention given to our animals, always very professional and helping!
Professional and very welcoming
They treated my cat nicely, respecting when he seemed stressed out, and were also quick to fix a mistake on my documentation when pointed out.
Easy to book the appointment with the vet who is in charge of your pet. Very warmly, politely, patient and efficient.

Thank you for the 5-star review! Your trust means a lot to our entire team.

Thank you for the 5-star review. Your trust means a lot to our whole team.

Before the visit I was very nervous, but right after I felt calm and even my doctor was very happy. A great team, the attending physician was fantastic.

Thank you so much.

So disappointed in this clinic since they changed hands . After paying an exorbitant amount of money for a dental procedure. My cat was not the same. He has been shaking his head and just appears uncomfortable. After not one not two but three visits. They finally decided to swab him. Guess what they found? Yeast in his ears! After billing me on two separate occasions for three separate visits, before finally deciding to actually do a swab. I will be going to another clinic as my cat has not been the same. When I explained how upset I was that he has been suffering for so long. I was told that I should not feel bad because not even the vets were able to tell that he had an ear infection. Which makes sense because all they did was look in his ears. My cat is clearly definitely still suffering.
But hopefully by taking him to another clinic, he will get treated properly
Dr. Chateauneuf is an excellent and very kind veterinarian :)) Thank you
Very nice and caring
I was completely satisfied. Thank you to the whole team.

I had a very poor experience with this clinic when I had to put my cat down. I do NOT reccomend this clinic at all. They lost my cat's ink paw print. I had asked to have it done 4 times during the visit, it was very important to me to have it. They dont have any protocols in place to avoid losing such an important piece of memory. Their solution was to offer a $100 refund, I find this borderline insulting after being charged around $1700 in less than 2 weeks for my cat by them . Very dissapointing. Do NOT reccomend their service. They also gave us the wrong color for the clay paw print. I would give zero stars if it was possible.

We have had a good experience with each vet here, most recently Dr Simon Chateauneuf (we have seen Dr Anne Catherine and Dr Proulx before- all excellent)! We appreciate the realistic recommendations and appointment options for our 5 cats. They often see them together to make for less trips to the vet for us. Not all 5 cats are angels at the vet so THANK YOU to the front desk, techs, and veterinarians.
Josh and Dr. Robinson took my puppy and I in for an emergency at 8:59PM and took such good care of us. I can’t recommend this place enough, thank you again for your service 🤍 …
Thank you for this great review!
Thank you so much for this 5 star review!

I'm incredibly thankful to have come across this clinic when we had a life threatening emergency with our dog. A special thank you to Josh, Dr. Forté, and Dr. Poulin for doing everything possible, staying late after hours to make sure our Shadow was okay and saving his life. The staff at the clinic are kind, caring and compassionate individuals. I can't recommend this vet enough. Thank you all.
Thank you for this great review!
Dr. Poulin is dedicated and amazing to her patients.

ARIANE DIVERNOIS
I denounce your petty and unjustified comment. Dr. Poulin has an extremely busy schedule because she is by far the best vet in Quebec. Despite a schedule that overflows day after day, she always finds the time to fit a suffering animal into her appointment, cutting into the 10 minutes she takes to quickly grab a bite of food. I've known her for over 16 years, and I don't know a vet with such a big heart and so sensitive to animal suffering. Your comment is completely gratuitous and false.
Is that correct, or am I mistaken? She still found time for you. As an excellent professional, she simply prioritized emergencies. Shame on you, Ariane DIVERNOIS.

Dr. Poulin is an exceptional veterinarian who truly cares about animal welfare. In emergency situations, she makes time in her schedule to try and see her little patients in need. My dog ​​has had recurring herniated discs this fall, and it's reassuring to know I can rely on Dr. Poulin's expertise.
Thank you for this great 5 star review!

The hours are great
Someone always there to take calls and answer any questions.
A Dr. will call you back if needed
Location is convenient and parking is easy

Honestly the best vet in Montreal imo. Last year my dog got hit by a car and we came here and they patched him up and gave him the best care I’ve seen. I also recently called for a few questions and they were super friendly and helpful definitely recommend them you won’t regret it!!!! Best staff ever
They are really passionate and take their time to explain everything. My dog loves them!
Extremely recommended
We thank you for this great review!
We thank you for this great review!
Highly recommand this clinic they took good care of my cat and gave me all of the informations that I needed
A fantastic and truly human experience, I highly recommend it.

I highly recommend this clinic. Excellent service, courteous, warm, and professional; they took such good care of me and my pet. Bravo! I highly recommend it; it was well worth the trip. Dr. Poulin and the staff are excellent; this will be my clinic for the future. What a shame I didn't know about it sooner!

We could not be more grateful for the staff here. We came in for our first time with a difficult decision for our elderly cat. The staff were so supportive, so patient and truly did an incredible job working with us and our cat.

Words fail me to express my gratitude, appreciation, and admiration for Dr. Poulin and her team. They are truly incredible. A professional, dedicated, passionate, and reassuring team. We have complete confidence in them and will continue to go to this clinic, despite the two-hour drive, because they are definitely the best team out there! No matter who we speak to, we feel reassured, listened to, and valued. Dr. Poulin and her team saved our beloved little cat when few believed it was possible, and provided her with exceptional care. Knowing she was in good hands lifted a huge weight off our shoulders. We thank them immensely for everything they did to save our cat's life. Their presence in our lives reassures us, because we know we are well supported no matter what. We will be forever grateful. We recommend this clinic to everyone without hesitation. They have been guardian angels on our journey and Whippet's. Whippet now has a second family. 🫶🏽🐾

Dr. Poulin is simply incredible. I adopted a puppy whose jaw was locked; she couldn't open her mouth. She could barely eat, and her teeth were starting to get infected. Several veterinarians couldn't find a solution to save her. Dr. Poulin quickly took her on. She operated, and today, a month post-surgery, my dog ​​is in great shape, and her jaw is fully functional. It's a miracle! I am extremely grateful and will definitely go to her for my dog's future care. In addition, all the staff at the clinic are kind and welcoming.

Such a fantastic clinic! The staff are super accommodating and always responsive to any questions we have. Dr Simon Chateauneuf and Dr Poulin have both treated my dog Bowie. Being a Great Dane, he is a big dog with big health problems but both vets are extremely attentive and innovative with their techniques/approaches. Cannot say enough good things about this clinic.

The team was awesome. First, they took us as an emergency on a Monday evening in between 2 appointments. I had called multiple clinics before and wasn't thrilled about paying the emergency DMV prices nor to take time away from bigger cases. The Animal Health Clinic was literally a life saver. We felt so welcome and cared for there. That's even if my dog was agressive during the exam and procedure, given we came in with an open wound. 4 staff came in to help keep my dog calm, which was impressive to see how they worked as a team. I felt in good hands and despite the bad circumstances that led us there, we left with ligther hearts.  I would recommend them blindly. Thank you again from Cielo and us!

Was there a few days ago with my 17 year old dog who has an ear infection they swabbed her ears, cleaned her ears and sent us home with an antibiotic for yeast. When I got to the front desk to pay they slapped me with a $315 dollar bill. I was in complete shock when I asked why so expensive the receptionist said the consult fees and medication, I have never paid this much for my dog who has recurring ear infections, needless to say I only went there because my vet was on vacation, I will never return there very money hungry
Everyone here is so friendly and kind!
This clonic provides great service, they listen to your concerns and see to it that you furbaby is in good hands. The staff are very warm and genuine.

Sorry, I should have left this comment three years ago, but I just created my first commenting account (because I encountered two incredibly mean Starbucks employees  by the way, those girls always gave other dogs large pop cups, while they only gave Niuniu a bottle cap-sized pop cup. Always!).

I'm Niuniu's mom. Niuniu's surgery (for a mast cell tumor) three years ago was actually successful, but we all know what a malignant tumor can mean. This time, we had to do a second surgery, which was also very successful. Everyone was very hardworking and friendly. The cost was $1,700, which I'm very satisfied with. I had originally planned to pay $4,000.

Niuniu is doing well now. I just heard you called, and thank you so much for your concern. Guys, I want to say that the staff at this hospital are wonderful, but the doctors aren't perfect, they're not superhuman. As owners, for the sake of our pets' health, we should pay close attention to any changes in their bodies to prevent their condition from worsening. Of course, if the condition worsens, it will cost more effort and money.

Below is a photo of Niuniu today. I have to complain again that my niece was treated kindly at another Starbucks and Niuniu also got a normal-sized pop cup.

For over 17 years now, I've only dealt with Dr. Isabelle Poulin. What a professional, attentive, a good listener, passionate, and compassionate! In short, I swear by her. My Frenchie adores her, and what can I say about my two cats (Juliette and Tom Thumb)? I think they dream about Dr. Poulin at night! Thank you so much for the outstanding, impeccable, fair, and honest service. I wish I were a pet just so I could benefit from her services a thousand times over! Thank you a thousand times over.
Professional and empathetic, I highly recommend him
Perfect vet experience ever, my cat gets great care.

I wanted to take the time to leave a review for Dr. Simon Chateauneuf. He is the best vet that has ever treated my dog. He is hands on, kind, listens to all my concerns, proposes different options for treatment, and educates me. I feel at ease with Dr. Chateauneuf, I don’t feel rushed and I don’t just feel like a number. He genuinely cares and wants what’s best for my baby as well as what’s realistic within my means. I know that I can rely on him and he always follows up when he says he will. He is a true gem!
We remain at your disposal should you wish to discuss your experience in person or have any questions about your pet. You can contact our manager, Vanessa, at 514-369-9119.

Le Dr Châteauneuf et toute l'équipe sont vraiment extraordinaires.
They genuinely care, are always available, and support you throughout the entire process. We're going through a very difficult time with our pet, and their compassion, responsiveness, and dedication mean the world to us. I highly recommend this clinic for their professionalism, exceptional team, thoughtful advice, and unwavering support.

Very friendly and knowledgeable vets and staff.  Our cat and puppy are in good hands.  Thanks for caring for our animals!
Jonathan & Monique
(Da Vinci -cat, Rosie -puppy) ❤️❤️

I had a very disappointing experience with this clinic. Vet et nous seemed disinterested and unmotivated, showing little concern for my pet’s condition. It felt rushed and impersonal, as if they just wanted to get through the appointment without really listening or offering thoughtful care. I left feeling frustrated and let down. I wouldn’t recommend this place if you’re looking for a vet who genuinely cares about dogs.
Dr. Poulin is the best veterinarian. She understands our animal, she is reassuring and available to answer all our questions without rushing us.
Very friendly staff and the services are great! I feel really comfortable coming here and I’ve been to a couple veterinary clinics, but will be sticking with this clinic! Thanks for your help :)

I used to have faith in this clinic, but my experiences have become increasingly disappointing. While one of their veterinarians is genuinely skilled and compassionate, the front desk staff is a different story. They are rude, incompetent, and seem more focused on their own agendas than on providing quality service.

To make matters worse, they consistently overcharge for services and deny accountability when issues arise. It feels like they prioritize profit over pet care. The staff's "woke" attitudes only add to the frustration, highlighting a lack of professionalism that is unacceptable in a veterinary clinic.

My family relied on this clinic for over 20 years before it was sold to a public company, and it’s disheartening to see such a decline. Stay far away—perhaps you’ll have a better experience, but eventually, their incompetence will catch up with you.  Take the time to read their horrible  reviews because a lot of people  share my sentiment.  As soon as you call them out, they deflect and make it about you because they don’t care about pets they care about $$$$$

WILL NEVER RETURN HERE — ABSOLUTELY HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE!

I brought my dog to Vet et Nous due to a clear and concerning decline in his function. What did they do? Barely any evaluation, no thorough assessment, and the only “solution” I got was that he should lose weight & was given a calorie restriction.

WEEKS LATER, my dog went completely blind. I was devastated. I called to try and get help — and the receptionists were unbelievably cold, and completely unprofessional. Zero compassion. I was told I’d have to pay full price again even though this was clearly a follow-up related to the same issue. When I pushed back, they told me to “take it up with management”.
The vet didn’t even bother to call me back until FIVE DAYS LATER — by then it was too late. I rushed to Gilmour’s Vet across the street who IMMEDIATELY found that my dog had dangerously high blood pressure and needed medication. Why wasn’t this caught the first time?

Vet et Nous failed my dog. They failed to investigate properly, failed to follow up, and failed to care. If they had taken my concerns seriously, my poor 8-year-old chihuahua might still have his vision today.
I regret ever stepping foot in this clinic. If you truly care about your pet, go to Gilmour Vet instead. They were competent, fast, and actually gave a damn.

This place is just a “business” that try to sell products. The atmosphere between the staff is also incredibly immature.
Always a smooth experience!

I always have great service at this clinic!  They are so helpful with my stranger agressive dog and really take their time to give him the best possible experience,  they explain everything very well.  I will definitely continue to bring my dog to this clinic 😊 …
Dr. Chateauneuf is very attentive; we felt listened to. I highly recommend him.
